findings.highlight: It’s exactly like the time I got attacked by Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に襲われた時の再現か
findings.governingReading: Is this a recreation of when Tohsaka attacked me?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative recognition of reenacting a tactic becomes categorical identity with the prior event.

findings.highlight: Things made out of inhuman bones
findings.evidenceJa: 人ではないモノの骨で作られた人形
findings.governingReading: dolls made from the bones of something nonhuman
findings.explanation: The enemies’ constructed doll nature becomes generic “things.”

findings.highlight: the bones
findings.evidenceJa: 奇怪な骨人形
findings.governingReading: the grotesque bone puppets
findings.explanation: The enemies are reduced from animated constructs to loose bones.

findings.highlight: bone creature
findings.evidenceJa: 骨人形
findings.governingReading: bone puppet
findings.explanation: The repeated construct term becomes a generic creature.

findings.highlight: sadness
findings.evidenceJa: 悲壮
findings.governingReading: grim, tragic resolve
findings.explanation: One of Shirou’s frozen normal responses is determined resolve under tragedy, not ordinary sadness.

findings.highlight: cowardice
findings.evidenceJa: 逃走
findings.governingReading: the urge to flee
findings.explanation: A survival response is moralized into a character flaw.

findings.highlight: the two swords
findings.evidenceJa: 二つの武器
findings.governingReading: the two weapons
findings.explanation: The reinforced chair legs are prematurely recast as actual swords.

findings.highlight: swing them like I saw him use them
findings.evidenceJa: ただ見よう見まねで振り続ける
findings.governingReading: keep swinging them through sheer visual imitation
findings.explanation: The English adds an unspecified male model and a more concrete copied technique.

findings.highlight: I smash the fourth bone creature
findings.evidenceJa: 四体目の骨を薙ぎ払う
findings.governingReading: I sweep the fourth bone puppet aside
findings.explanation: The lateral clearing action is replaced by another generic smash.

findings.highlight: gets smashed and smacked into a wall
findings.evidenceJa: 今までにないほど砕け
findings.governingReading: shatters more thoroughly than any before and is hurled into the wall
findings.explanation: The escalation caused by Shirou protecting Rin disappears.

findings.highlight: I attack the defenseless body with the weapon in my left hand
findings.evidenceJa: 左の武器を叩きつけた
findings.governingReading: I slam the left-hand weapon into its exposed torso
findings.explanation: Concrete two-weapon choreography is reduced to generic attack.

findings.highlight: But there are more of them.
findings.evidenceJa: だが数は減らない
findings.governingReading: But their number does not diminish
findings.explanation: The pressure comes from no visible reduction despite kills, not simply the existence of more enemies.

findings.highlight: Ein K[ouml]rper ist ein K[ouml]rper
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=灰]r[ruby text=は]p[ruby text=灰]e[ruby text=に]r ist e[ruby text=塵]i[ruby text=は]n[ruby text=塵]
findings.governingReading: The surface incantation carries a ruby layer reading “ashes to ashes, dust to dust”
findings.explanation: The entire semantic ruby layer of Rin’s incantation disappears.

findings.highlight: as she beholds the scene in horror
findings.evidenceJa: 何らかの感情を抑える為か
findings.governingReading: perhaps to suppress some emotion
findings.explanation: The narration deliberately leaves Rin’s emotion unidentified; the English fixes it as horror.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka goes near Shinji
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二に詰め寄る遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin closes in on Shinji
findings.explanation: Rin’s threatening pressure becomes neutral proximity.

findings.highlight: it’s not me that killed her
findings.evidenceJa: 殺したのは僕じゃない
findings.governingReading: I’m not the one who killed [them/it]
findings.explanation: Before Rider is revealed on the floor, the English supplies a female victim and spoils the staged discovery.

findings.highlight: students that fell unconscious
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れ伏した生徒たち
findings.governingReading: the collapsed students
findings.explanation: The students’ visible posture becomes a confirmed diagnosis before Shirou checks them.

findings.highlight: a jack
findings.evidenceJa: 万力か何か
findings.governingReading: a vise or similar crushing tool
findings.explanation: The imagined implement producing Rider’s wound is mistranslated.

findings.highlight: It might be annoying having you run around
findings.evidenceJa: うろちょろして見苦しい
findings.governingReading: your scurrying about may be unsightly
findings.explanation: Rin’s contempt for Shinji’s undignified movement becomes personal annoyance.

findings.highlight: biting her lips in vexation
findings.evidenceJa: 悔しげに歯を噛んでいる
findings.governingReading: gritting her teeth in frustration
findings.explanation: The bodily sign of contained emotion is assigned to the wrong part of the mouth.

findings.highlight: a mature magus
findings.evidenceJa: 一人前の魔術師
findings.governingReading: a full-fledged magus
findings.explanation: Professional competence is changed into personal maturity, muddying the contrast with a girl her age.

findings.highlight: My head got all boiled up
findings.evidenceJa: 目の前が真っ赤になった
findings.governingReading: I saw red
findings.explanation: Shirou’s visual anger idiom becomes an invented boiled-head image.
